game.title: The Bureau: XCOM Declassified
game.blurb: Squad-based third-person shooter from 2K Marin (RAWG also lists 2K), published by 2K Games, released 2013-08-20. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The campaign's story milestones, hidden on Steam. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Agents, Dispatch and Operations
chapters.summary: Agent classes and ranks, customising agents, Dispatch Missions, Minor Operations and base Investigations.

chapters.title: Difficulty and Challenge Runs
chapters.summary: Commander difficulty, no agent bleeding out, an Operation without firing, and clearing the Outsiders before the Skyranger escape.

chapters.title: Combat and Abilities
chapters.summary: Headshots, sticky grenades, melee, scans, laser guns against shields, Battle Focus commands, Mutons, flanking and mind control.

chapters.title: Hangar 6 R&D
chapters.summary: The Hangar 6 R&D campaign and DaSilva's demo charges and perk tree, plus three rare hidden achievements next to them in the list.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3932). Steam app 65930 is "The Bureau: XCOM Declassified" in the store list; its achievement schema calls it "ValveTestApp65930" (a placeholder name). 13 of 41 Steam achievements are hidden. Ten of them (Achievement_9 to 11 and 16 to 22, 16% to 54%) look like story milestones and sit in the main story chapter. The other three (Achievement_35 to 37: "Conduit Connection", "Drive Through", "It's In The Air", 3.1% to 4.0%) sit just before the four Hangar 6 R&D achievements (2.6% to 2.7%) in the Steam list and are about as rare, so they were put in the Hangar 6 R&D chapter, a reasoned guess; the data does not say what they need. RAWG lists no additions for this game. StrategyWiki has no page under "The Bureau: XCOM Declassified" or "The Bureau". xcom.fandom.com answers the API under "The Bureau: XCOM Declassified" with about 11 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
